what_it_does: Provides tools to help scientists lower the numerical precision of their code from 64-bit floating point down to 16-bit floating point. Modern supercomputers increasingly have more 16-bit and 32-bit arithmetic units than full 64-bit units, so optimizing which parts of an application can safely run at lower precision improves both speed and energy efficiency. RAPTOR is an LLVM-based profiler that automatically identifies where precision reduction is feasible.
